summary: Sprint-08 verification of Trip Inspection AI tiering (Fast=Flash / Thorough=Pro) + per-section streaming endpoints + auto-case routing via /finalize. Backend pytest 5/5 PASSED. Frontend E2E PASSED end-to-end (login → /trip → upload → mode toggle → analyze → streaming banner → finalize → cost summary + coverage + auto-case banner with /cases/<id> link + PDF export + result clears on mode switch). SAR currency everywhere, no QAR.

Frontend: /trip route streaming UX, mode toggle clears, auto-case banner + view-case link, PDF export, streaming banner lifecycle.

critical_code_review_comments: trip_inspection_service.py:182-187 _model_for_mode falls back to the THOROUGH model name if DI_AI_MODEL_DAMAGE_FAST_NAME is missing from .env. In the current deployment the FAST env var is NOT explicitly set, but the default 'gemini-3.5-flash' is correctly returned and Gemini accepted it. Recommend adding DI_AI_MODEL_DAMAGE_FAST_NAME to /app/backend/.env explicitly to avoid ambiguity if defaults change.

trip_inspection_service.py:432-526 _maybe_auto_create_case wraps the whole persistence path in a broad 'except Exception' that silently returns created=false with reason='error'. This is correct policy (auto-routing must never break the advisory response) but it would mask real DB / case-service bugs. Recommend at minimum logging the exception with correlation_id before swallowing.

trip_inspection.py:96-113 finalize endpoint accepts arbitrary client-supplied section dicts including modelVersion and estimatedCost. A malicious client could synthesise NEW items with low confidence to force an auto-case creation. Acceptable for an internal advisory tool, but consider re-running section normalization server-side in finalize (currently only _aggregate_result runs) before allowing auto_case to act on the data.

TripInspection.jsx pending placeholder (trip-pending-exterior-front) is so short-lived under Flash (<5s) that it can flicker imperceptibly when only one section is in flight. Cosmetic only — the streaming-banner correctly carries the user's progress signal until finalize returns.
seed_data_creation: Test created N inspection sessions + di_ai_findings + 1 damage case under TENANT-000001 via the auto-case path of test_finalize_creates_auto_case_when_above_threshold (acceptable per the request's note that the auto-case path may persist data). Also created 1 real damage case during the frontend E2E run (caseId 6a43c66f9bb8d8d1142b1525, plate auto-generated as TRIP-<uuid>).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For trip inspection streaming testing: (1) The data-testid for the file input is ON the hidden <input>, so use `page.set_input_files('[data-testid=trip-front-before]', path)` — DO NOT chain ' input[type=file]'. (2) /trip default state already has FRONT selected and the file inputs rendered. (3) Mode toggle calls clear() so it resets `result` to null — that's why switching modes wipes the cost-summary. (4) Flash returns in ~5-10s so the per-area pending placeholder may disappear before a 5s polling selector catches it; use the streaming-banner instead as the in-flight indicator. (5) Synthetic damage in /app/backend/tests/stress/after_0.jpg reliably triggers a NEW finding whose cost-high crosses the 1000 SAR threshold → autoCase.created=true. (6) finalize is synchronous & cheap (<1s) but does open a Mongo connection through inspection_service + damage_case_service for the auto-case branch.
